evidence.quote: for pending orders, I can only modify the items to different options of the same product type

observed_facts: The agent claimed that pending orders cannot have items removed, only modified to different options or the whole order cancelled.
The user wanted to remove the fleece jacket by mistake, or cancel the order if removing is not possible, and also wanted to modify a skateboard and find the total price of all grills.
inference: The agent hallucinated a system limitation that pending orders cannot be cancelled or modified via specific item cancellation, refusing to cancel when the user stated they wanted it removed/cancelled if not possible.
The agent gave up and transferred the user prematurely without addressing the other parts of the user request (skateboards, grills).
needs_verification: Check whether the retail agent policy or tools actually support removing an item from a pending order versus cancelling the entire order.
parsed.summary: The agent invented a false system limitation regarding pending order modifications and failed to address all user requests before transferring.
